# Zentirog Discord Username Market

> Zentirog is the premier marketplace for rare, 3-letter, 4-letter, and clean dictionary Discord usernames and pre-claimed accounts with verified escrow protection.

## Overview
Zentirog connects digital asset buyers with exclusive, rare Discord usernames. All usernames are delivered on verified pre-claimed Discord accounts with full email, password, and 2FA transfer ownership.

## Marketplace Inventory & Categories
- [3-Letter (3L) Discord Usernames](https://www.zentirog.com/): Ultra-rare 3-character vanity identifiers.
- [4-Letter (4L) Discord Usernames](https://www.zentirog.com/): Clean, pronounceable 4-character handles.
- [Clean Dictionary Usernames](https://www.zentirog.com/): Real English dictionary words, prestige terms, and brandable handles.
- [Semi-OG & Gaming Usernames](https://www.zentirog.com/): Aesthetic, cultural, and gaming moniker identifiers.

## Buyer Protection & Escrow Protocol
- Ownership Guarantee: Every account credentials set is verified in vault cold storage before release.
- Transfer Protocol: Buyers take immediate ownership by updating email, password, and enabling two-factor authentication (2FA).
- Verified Support: Direct transfer support and verification via official Discord desk.
